title: Channel Sales Support Agent
description:
Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn’t work together.
So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions - to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.
Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes - large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We’re building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.
 The Role
The Channel Sales Support Agent is the operational backbone for our independent contractor (IC) sales teams in the field. You’ll be their go-to person-making sure they have everything they need to successfully sell and onboard our products to local sellers across Australia.
This isn’t just a support role. You’re enabling entrepreneurs to build their businesses, and their success is your success.
 You’re someone who
 Thrives in fast-paced environments - You stay calm when things move quickly and priorities shift
 Genuinely enjoys helping others succeed - You get satisfaction from unblocking problems and empowering people
 Takes ownership - When you pick up a problem, you see it through to resolution
 Sho…

title: Manager, Software Engineering (Code Standards)
description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.
 About the Engineering team
The Engineering team builds systems that power Affirm’s mission. We take pride in our craft, building reliable, performant, and scalable solutions that touch every part of the business. Whether we’re enabling new ways to pay, ensuring our platforms can scale to the most demanding levels in the industry, or developing seamless servicing experiences, our focus is on solving complex problems through exceptional engineering.
 About the role
 Lead the Code Standards team within Developer Productivity, helping Affirm engineers build on current, reliable languages, libraries, and tooling. You’ll grow a team spanning Python and Kotlin, guide technical strategy, and make upgrades routine through shared frameworks and automation, improving developer speed and the reliability of Affirm’s products.
 What you'll do
 Lead, hire, and develop a team of engineers across Python and Kotlin tooling. Set clear expectations, provide regular feedback, and build shared ownership and knowledge across the team.
 Set the technical strategy and roadmap for getting Affirm’s languages and dependencies current and keeping them current. Translate that direction into achievable quarterly goals, balancing migration risk, developer needs, operational work, and team capacity.
 Drive runtime and dependency upgrades across a large production codebase. Guide compatibility testing, staged rollouts, and recovery plans with service owners and security partners so teams can adopt supported versions safely.
 Evolve shared libraries, dependency management, and build tooling for Python and Kotlin services. Make code easier to build, maintain, and extend through clear package boundaries, versioning, reusable configuration, and automated standards.
 Turn repeated migration work into reliable upgrade workflows…

title: Associate Manager, SOX and Internal Controls
description:
Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase , we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” Learn more about working at Coinbase .
About the team
The Finance Controls team helps management establish and maintain effective internal controls over financial reporting. We partner closely with control owners, Finance and Accounting leaders, Internal Audit, external auditors, Technology and Security teams, Legal, Compliance, and other cross-functional partners to strengthen the control environment and support reliable financial reporting.
As an Associate Manager, SOX & Internal Controls, you'll own a defined set of business processes within Coinbase's SOX and SOC 1 programs from end to end. Our Internal Controls team keeps Coinbase audit-ready by designing, documenting, and monitoring the controls that safeguard financial reporting across a fast-changing crypto platform. You'll bring a technology lens to controls work, mapping data flows from source systems to financial statements, evaluating automated control evidence, and driving remediation when gaps arise.
What you'll do:
 Own assigned SOX business processes end to end, including process narratives, risk-and-control matrices, key systems, automated controls, and business process controls, keeping each area audit-ready through continuous documentation and design updates.
